label: Bible Study
prompt: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the _____,
verse: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
note: Hebrews opens with history — God spoke many ways before speaking through his Son.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For this child I _____; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
verse: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:
note: Hannah, who once wept at Shiloh for a child, brings little Samuel back: for this child I prayed.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called _____, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
verse: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
note: A lame man begged daily at the temple gate called Beautiful — until Peter offered something better than alms.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our _____, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
verse: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
note: Paul's case for reading the Old Testament: it was written for us, to fuel patience, comfort and hope.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his _____, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verse: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
note: 'Subtilty' is the KJV's spelling of subtlety — the serpent's cunning that beguiled Eve in the garden.
